jobs.title: Chef d'équipe logistique (H/F)
jobs.description: En bref Picnic grandit vite, et notre centre de préparation de commandes de Fretin a besoin de pilotes pour porter cette ambition. En tant que Captain, tu n es pas juste un(e) chef(fe) d équipe : tu es le moteur de l entrepôt. Ton défi ? Manager environ 20 Shoppers (préparateur(rice)s de commandes) en direct, garantir une sécurité totale et transformer chaque shift en succès collectif avec +100 Shoppers sur le terrain. Si tu aimes l action et que tu sais fédérer une équipe dans la bonne humeur, ce rôle est pour toi. Tes missions Manager et coacher ton équipe : Tu supervises une vingtaine de Shoppers au quotidien, en veillant à leur motivation, leur sécurité et au respect des bonnes pratiques. Piloter la performance : Tu garantis que chaque commande est prête, complète et à l heure, en suivant de près nos indicateurs de qualité. Coordonner les flux du FC : Tu travailles main dans la main avec les autres Captains pour fluidifier les opérations et ajuster les ressources en temps réel. Assurer la polyvalence opérationnelle : Réception, gestion des stocks (sec, frais, surgelé) ou départ des camions... tu navigues entre les zones selon les besoins du planning. Gérer l humain et le terrain : Tu es le point de contact privilégié pour ton équipe, capable de recadrer avec pédagogie comme de féliciter les réussites. Organisation du temps de travail : 35 heures travaillées réparties sur 4 jours par semaine. 3 jours de repos chaque semaine. Travail le week-end, dimanche inclus, à raison de 3 semaines par mois. Des shifts tournants selon les besoins de l activité. À propos de toi Tu as entre 1 et 5 ans d expérience dans un environnement dynamique (logistique, retail, restauration ou ligne de production) avec une première gestion d équipe réussie. Tu maîtrises le français (l anglais est un plus) et tu es parfaitement à l aise avec les outils digitaux de pilotage. Tu es véhiculé(e) pour rejoindre facilement l entrepôt de Fretin. Tu n as pas peur de mettre la main à la pâte. Tu aime

About the Role: Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our Benelux, and Nordics regions. This is a player-coach role. You'll be taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing. You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves. Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast. You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do. jobs.title: General Capabilities - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. jobs.title: COOK HELPER
jobs.description: COOK HELPER Bergabunglah Bersama Tim Kitchen Kami! Kami mencari individu yang rajin, disiplin, cekatan, dan memiliki semangat kerja sama untuk bergabung sebagai Cook Helper dalam mendukung kelancaran operasional dapur. DESKRIPSI PEKERJAAN * Membantu Cook dan Chef dalam persiapan bahan makanan (food preparation). * Mencuci, memotong, dan menyiapkan bahan sesuai standar dapur. * Menjaga kebersihan area kerja, peralatan, dan perlengkapan dapur. * Membantu proses penyimpanan bahan makanan sesuai standar kebersihan dan keamanan pangan. * Memastikan ketersediaan bahan baku selama operasional. * Membantu kelancaran operasional dapur sesuai arahan atasan. KUALIFIKASI * Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. * Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Cook Helper menjadi nilai tambah. * Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar. * Memiliki kondisi fisik yang baik dan mampu bekerja dengan ritme dapur yang dinamis. * Rajin, jujur, disiplin, cekatan, dan bertanggung jawab. * Mampu bekerja sama dalam tim serta mengikuti arahan atasan. * Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur sesuai jadwal. BENEFIT * Gaji kompetitif sesuai kualifikasi dan pengalaman. * Uang makan. * BPJS Kesehatan dan Ketenagakerjaan sesuai ketentuan perusahaan. * Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan suportif. * Kesempatan belajar, mengembangkan keterampilan, dan meningkatkan jenjang karier. TERTARIK BERGABUNG? Jadilah bagian dari tim kami dan kembangkan kemampuanmu bersama lingkungan kerja yang positif dan profesional.

jobs.title: Alignment Research Manager
jobs.description: AE Studio is a 160-person ML consultancy dedicated to solving the hardest problems in AI. We use our profits to fund research on the most important problems in AI Safety and Alignment. We partner with top researchers from both academia and industry, including Anthropic, Goodfire AI, Redwood, Princeton, MATS, RAND Corporation, and others. Our research is published in top ML conferences and currently deployed in safety-critical systems. AE Studio was founded 10 years ago with the goal of helping corporate clients develop humanity-affirming, agency-promoting technology. Since then we’ve developed a reputation for rapidly delivering world-class solutions to their hardest problems. We take the same client-centric approach to research, partnering with the world’s best external researchers to develop world-class results. They provide the vision and our researchers make their ideas a reality. Our core alignment team is 25 researchers and growing. We hire from all backgrounds. Whether you’re an independent researcher, an engineer, or an academic, AE is a place to make real impact on the single most important problem of our time. We research a diverse set of ambitious alignment directions that others neglect, including pretraining interventions for model safety, novel interpretability techniques, neuroscience-inspired approaches to alignment, and many others. You can learn more about our team and work from our Alignment Podcast as well as our research page . About the role You will be the person who makes the research acceleration model actually run. You own projects end to end: turning abstract research ideas into clear roadmaps, keeping technical teams unblocked and moving fast, and making sure progress is visible to leadership, collaborators, and funders. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Site Merchandising UK
jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity We're looking for a Director of Research to own our Text-to-Speech program end to end — the research strategy, the technical bets

jobs.title: E commerce Account Specialist

Your responsibilities will extend to coordinating closely with the Marketing and Merchandising Planning and Control Department to ensure alignment between online sales strategies and overall business objectives. This is an onsite position at Armal Compound 2, M. Eusebio Avenue, San Miguel, Pasig City. Roles and responsibilities Manage and maintain e-commerce platforms to showcase latest trends and collections, optimizing product titles, descriptions, and imagery. Partner with Marketing to align our online sales strategies with the captivating campaigns they craft. Collaborate closely with our Merchandising Planning and Control Department to ensure our online assortments are in sync with our offline offerings, creating a seamless shopping experience for our customers. Analyze performance data to uncover actionable insights that refine promotional calendars and product assortment. Resolve customer inquiries with empathy and efficiency to create memorable and meaningful experiences and build brand loyalty for Fashion Fusion Bring collaborative spirit, working closely with cross-functional teams like Store Operations, Fulfillment, and Customer Service to ensure our online operations run smoothly. Share your knowledge and insights with your teammates, fostering a culture of continuous leaming and growth. Perform other related duties and functions as assigned by the company.

jobs.title: Senior Media Relations Manager
jobs.description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let s get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: You would own Mews relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day. You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Safety
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. What you'll work on Develop mid- and post-training safety methods for FLUX models, such as safety SFT, preference optimization and RL with safety rewards, and concept erasure. Build safety data filtering that runs at pretraining scale: classifiers and pipelines that screen billions of images, video clips and captions, with measured Pareto frontiers and precision/recall trade-offs. jobs.title: PhD Researcher – Video Understanding & VLMs
jobs.description: About Almetra We build vision-language models that understand what happens on real factory floors. Cameras on 20+ production lines stream video into our models, which turn every step (assembling, screwing, inspecting) into structured data several times per second. Customers use it to see where time gets lost and how to improve their processes. Your role You’ll do your PhD with us from day one, working closely with Sascha, our Head of ML (VLM), on research problems that come straight from our product. Your research runs on real industrial video at a scale few academic labs have. The PhD is co-supervised by a university professor, and you’ll be enrolled at a partner university. What you’ll work on Video understanding with VLMs: action recognition, temporal grounding and long-video reasoning on factory footage Making models robust in the real world: occlusions, unusual viewpoints, new stations and products with little labelled data Turning research results into improvements in our production models Publishing at top venues (CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR) together with our ML team What you bring Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a closely related field, with a focus on computer vision or multimodal learning (finished or finishing by early-2027) Solid deep learning foundations and hands-on PyTorch Experience with computer vision, video or multimodal models (thesis, projects or internships) Curiosity about real-world problems, not only benchmarks Fluent English Nice to have First publications or a strong thesis in vision-language, video understanding or multimodal learning Experience with open VLMs (e.g. Qwen-VL, InternVL, LLaVA) or video models (e.g. VideoMAE, ViViT) Training on GPU clusters (DDP / FSDP) Why a PhD with us A full-time, paid PhD position in Berlin Mentoring from our Head of ML plus academic co-supervision Unique real-world video data and the compute to use it Your research reaches a real product, not just a paper What we offer E

jobs.description: Als Verkaufsberater im Flagship Store machst du unsere Pergolen für Kund erlebbar und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Kaufabschluss. Du verstehst ihre Wünsche, präsentierst Produkte und Zubehör und empfiehlst die passende Lösung für ihren Außenbereich. Dabei betreust du deine Kundenkontakte eigenverantwortlich, fasst Angebote verbindlich nach und gestaltest mit, wie Kund PERGOLUX in unserem Flagship Store erleben. PERGOLUX entwirft und verkauft skandinavisch inspirierte Outdoor-Living-Produkte wie Pergolen und Gartenmöbel direkt an Endkund. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeiter, einem neunstelligen Umsatz und Aktivitäten in acht Märkten sind wir über die Jahre stetig gewachsen – in Europa und darüber hinaus. Deine Aufgaben Kund:innen beraten: Du findest heraus, was unsere Kund für ihren Außenbereich brauchen, und empfiehlst passende Pergolen, Ausstattungsvarianten und Zubehör. Produkte erlebbar machen: Du führst unsere Produkte im Flagship Store vor und erklärst Funktionen, Materialien und Maße verständlich und anschaulich. Abschlüsse erzielen: Du erstellst Angebote, klärst Rückfragen und fasst verbindlich nach – persönlich, telefonisch und per E-Mail. Deine Verkaufsgespräche begleitest du eigenverantwortlich bis zum Abschluss. Den Überblick behalten: Du dokumentierst Kundenwünsche, Angebote, Termine und nächste Schritte im CRM und hältst vereinbarte Rückmeldungen zuverlässig ein. Mit anpacken: Du hältst den Flagship Store gepflegt und vorführbereit, bringst Ideen für die Produktpräsentation ein und unterstützt Verkaufsaktionen. Dein Profil Freude am Verkauf: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, hörst aufmerksam zu und überzeugst mit Lösungen, die zu ihren Bedürfnissen passen. Passende Erfahrung: Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im beratungsintensiven Verkauf mit – etwa mit Terrassenüberdachungen, Fenstern, Türen, Wintergärten, Bauelementen, Möbeln oder Küchen. Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst mit Maßen, Materialien und Produktdetails umgehen und möchtest dir fundiertes

jobs.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
jobs.description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. jobs.description: Description du poste : Contexte Dans le cadre de l’amélioration continue de nos processus internes, nous souhaitons renforcer et structurer notre démarche qualité à l’échelle de l’entreprise. jobs.title: Quality Manager (all genders) – Quality & Sustainability
jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Du bist Teil des Produktteams und verantwortest den gesamten Qualitätsbereich sowie die Einhaltung relevanter Qualitäts- und Futtermittelstandards bei mammaly. Du stehst im engen Austausch mit unseren Lieferanten, führst regelmäßige Audits durch und begleitest wichtige Produktionen vor Ort. Du analysierst regelmäßig Kundenreklamationen und überprüfst unseren Warenbestand, um mögliche Qualitätsprobleme frühzeitig zu identifizieren. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams im Lager und an den Produktionsstandorten zusammen. Dazu gehören auch regelmäßige Dienstreisen für Vor-Ort-Besprechungen und Abstimmungen mit unseren Partnern. Du führst detaillierte Ursachenanalysen und Untersuchungen durch und leitest geeignete Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen (CAPA) ein. Du leitest Qualitätsinitiativen abteilungsübergreifend und stellst sicher, dass diese gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest den weiteren Aufbau unserer internen Qualitätssicherung und des Qualitätsmanagements. Dazu gehören die Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Qualitätssystemen, Dokumentenmanagement, SOPs, Formularen und Richtlinien. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Permanent Control
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Please make your application, including your CV, in English Language . We are a global compliance team headquartered out of London. About the role As a Senior Analyst – Permanent Controls , you will join the Permanent Controls team, a global Second Line of Defence (2LoD) function based across Paris and Mauritius. Reporting directly to the Head of Permanent Controls within the Compliance department, you will focus on the financial perimeter, exercising second-line control, independent oversight, and framework monitoring over the organization's finance domain. You will partner closely with the First Line of Defence (1LoD) to establish control standards, design control matrices, and provide guidance when needed. You will also execute 2LoD control plans, issue formal findings, and track recommendations through to resolution. No two days will be the same, offering a unique opportunity to make a real impact while gaining broad exposure across the business. jobs.description: Notre solution logicielle est utilisée par des traders dans les banques et entreprises d’investissement, et traite un grand volume de données en temps réel . Pour rendre ces informations compréhensibles et exploitables, une visualisation claire, interactive et ergonomique est essentielle. L’objectif du stage est de concevoir une bibliothèque web réutilisable permettant d’afficher dynamiquement des données financières complexes (prix, volatilité, paramètres d’algorithmes) dans des graphes interactifs, en commençant par les graphiques boursiers linéaires et les graphiques à barre Open High Low Close (OHLC) Tes missions : Accompagné par un développeur expert sur ces technologies, tu développeras un prototype de bibliothèque en HTML5, JavaScript et ReactJS , intégrable dans notre logiciel, avec des exemples d’utilisation concrets . Tu mettras en œuvre des fonctionnalités avancées d’interaction (zoom, sélection, modification de valeurs) pour offrir une expérience utilisateur fluide et pertinente . Tu rédigeras également la documentation technique de la bibliothèque. Pourquoi ce stage est pour toi Ce stage est une opportunité unique d’approfondir tes compétences en développement web moderne et en visualisation de données . Tu découvriras comment transformer des données complexes en interfaces claires et interactives, tout en travaillant au sein d’une équipe expérimentée. Tu utiliseras des outils comme GitLab et Docker, et contribueras à un produit innovant avec un impact direct sur les utilisateurs finaux. Het team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Relevante werkervaring: Je hebt 0–2 jaar werkervaring en affiniteit met de financiële sector en/of de gezondheidszorg. Data: Je hebt een affiniteit met data en bent in staat om klanten te helpen met optimale inzichten uit onze producten te halen. Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden, interne stakeholders en klanten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. Een WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri Taspen atau Bank Mantap adalah anak usaha Bank Mandiri yang terutama menyediakan jasa keuangan untuk pensiunan. Untuk mendukung kegiatan bisnisnya, hingga akhir tahun 2020, perusahaan ini memiliki 41 kantor cabang, 64 kantor cabang pembantu, 112 kantor kas, 3 kantor fungsional UMK, 53 kantor fungsional non operasional, dan 152 mobil kas yang tersebar di seantero Indonesia. Lowongan Kerja Bank Mandiri Taspen. Bank ini memulai sejarahnya di Denpasar pada tanggal 23 Februari 1970 sebagai sebuah Maskapai Andil Indonesia (MAI) dengan nama Bank Pasar Sinar Harapan Bali. Pada tanggal 3 November 1992, badan hukum bank ini diubah menjadi Perseroan Terbatas (PT) dengan nama Bank Sinar Harapan Bali. Pada tanggal 10 Maret 1994, bank ini ditetapkan sebagai sebuah bank umum. Pada tahun 2005, terbit peraturan baru dari Bank Indonesia yang mewajibkan bank umum untuk memiliki modal inti setidaknya sebanyak Rp 80 miliar paling lambat pada tanggal 31 Desember 2007. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Mandiri Taspen Saat ini PT Bank Mandiri Taspen membuka rekrutmen lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Business Service Admin Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Melaksanakan pengurusan administrasi mutasi dan flagging berkoordinasi dengan Business Service (BS). Berkoordinasi dengan mitra bisnis untuk persiapan sosialisasi seperti, BUP prapensiun :LKO, JKK, JKM Melakukan pengurusan Debitur BUP & dan membantu pengurusan pencairan THT Kualifikasi: Min. Lulusan D3 Terbuka untuk semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman dalam bidang Administrasi Menguasai Microsoft Office. Penempatan TRENGGALEK Tata Cara Melamar : Jika berminat dan memiliki kualifikasi yang di butuhkan perusahaan silahkan daftar secara online melalui link dibawah ini : DAFTAR Dikarenakan jumlah pendaftar yang cukup besar, hanya kandidat terpilih yang akan kami hubungi untuk menjalani tahap seleksi selanjutnya.
